title: SOC2 midday scratch: evidence & vendor quick hits
content:
Quick personal scratchpad for today — not formal. Use to capture tiny TODOs I don’t want to forget while doing evidence pulls and a vendor sanity-check.

Morning notes
- 09:15: pulled initial list of user access review reports (GCP IAM) — need full CSV export from audit-log-job.
- 10:02: Slack: sec-compliance thread — Maya asked for proof of KMS key rotation window. I have notes but missing exact rotation schedule doc.

Top priorities (short)
- [ ] Grab KMS rotation policy PDF from vault (path: s3://redwood-sec/keys/policy-rotations/) — confirm rotation cadence and last rotation timestamp.
- [ ] Export IAM role binding snapshot for prod accounts (Jira SEC-421) — include in evidence packet.
- [ ] Vendor check: Nimbus AI (PO #1452) — need SOC2 letter + encryption-at-rest statement.

Evidence checklist (for handoff to auditor)
- IAM snapshots (CSV): what I have vs what we need. I have partials from 2025; ask infra for 2026-02 full.
- KMS rotation policy doc (PDF) — may be in Confluence but canonical copy should be in vault.
- Change logs for onboarding/offboarding tickets (HR + IT) — link to hire/exit tickets (HR-880 / IT-219).
- SRE runbook excerpts (screenshots allowed) — must redact IP addresses.

Vendor mini-review (Nimbus AI) — quick pass notes
- Does Nimbus provide SOC2? (Q: their letter is 2024 — is it scoped to subservice for inference?)
- Encryption: they claim AES-256 at rest, TLS1.2+ in transit — ask for certificate of implementation (diagram).
- Subprocessors: they list 3 (DataFlowX, LogKeep, EdgeServe) — verify contracts, get subprocessors addendum.
- Action: email vendor-ops@redwood with request template (see linked artifact).

Policy TODOs (short-term)
- Update "Encryption-at-rest" section in security policy draft (marked inline as TODO-enc) — reference: feedback from legal (Maya).
- Retention schedule: ensure logs retention table includes 403/401 events for 365 days (SRE asked for 90d but compliance wants 365d). Clarify with SRE.
- Add small blurb to onboarding checklist: "confirm access role reviewed in 7 days" (makes evidence chain cleaner).

Handoff notes for Sam (if I go OOO)
- Sam: run SEC-421 export job (gcloud auth -> run: ./scripts/export-iam.sh prod) and drop CSV to evidence folder.
- Sam: email vendor-ops@ with subject "Nimbus AI: SOC2 + encryption artifacts request" and paste draft in Confluence page "Vendor intake templates".

Random scraps / things-to-check
- BLOCKER? audit-log-job failing on Monday morning; check infra ticket INF-702.
- Q: do we accept vendor self-attests for subprocessor mapping or require third-party verification? (legal preference?)
- Note to self: talk to Ben about automating KMS rotation evidence (snapshot of key metadata via API).

Snippets I might paste into Slack or Jira
- Slack quick: "Maya — working on KMS rotation doc, expect file in evidence bucket by EOD. If legal needs earlier, ping me."
- Jira comment for SEC-421: "Exported IAM snapshot placed in evidence folder s3://redwood-sec/evidence/SEC-421/ — awaiting validation."

Linked quick references (local ids / where I keep things)
- evidence-bucket: s3://redwood-sec/evidence/
- vendor templates: confluence.redwood.ai/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=99887766
- vendor intake draft (my copy): drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c4dVENDORDRAFT

End of scratch. Clean up later, move verified docs into shared_drives/security-and-compliance/evidence/ if accepted.

Notes-to-self (meta)
- Keep this doc short — copy important items into formal evidence.json before handing off to auditor.
- If I don’t finish KMS by EOD, create an interim note with exact missing timestamps for auditor.
